    <name>Soft Delete Case</name>
    <operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {
    var startTime = new GlideDateTime();
    var httpStatus = 200;
    var responseBody = {};
    var caseId = '';

    try {
        var pathCaseId = request.pathParams.case_id;

        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_2241073_securi_0_sec_case');
        if (!gr.get(pathCaseId)) {
            gr = new GlideRecord('x_2241073_securi_0_sec_case');
            gr.addQuery('number', pathCaseId);
            gr.query();
            if (!gr.next()) {
                httpStatus = 404;
                responseBody = {
                    error: {
                        message: 'Case not found',
                        detail: 'No Security Case found with identifier: ' + pathCaseId,
                        status: 404
                    }
                };
                response.setStatus(404);
                response.setBody(responseBody);
                _logWebhook(request, responseBody, httpStatus, startTime, caseId);
                return;
            }
        }

        caseId = gr.getUniqueValue();

        // Soft-delete: set state to Cancelled (8)
        gr.setValue('state', '8');
        gr.update();

        responseBody = {
            result: {
                sys_id: caseId,
                number: gr.getValue('number'),
                state: '8',
                status: 'cancelled'
            }
        };

        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(responseBody);

    } catch (e) {
        httpStatus = 500;
        responseBody = {
            error: {
                message: 'Internal server error',
                detail: e.toString(),
                status: 500
            }
        };
        response.setStatus(500);
        response.setBody(responseBody);
    }

    _logWebhook(request, responseBody, httpStatus, startTime, caseId);

})(request, response);

function _logWebhook(request, responseBody, httpStatus, startTime, caseId) {
    try {
        var endTime = new GlideDateTime();
        var duration = GlideDateTime.subtract(startTime, endTime);
        var durationMs = duration.getNumericValue();
        var log = new GlideRecord('x_2241073_securi_0_webhook_log');
        log.initialize();
        log.setValue('direction', 'inbound');
        log.setValue('endpoint_url', request.uri);
        log.setValue('http_method', 'DELETE');
        log.setValue('http_status', httpStatus);
        log.setValue('payload', '');
        log.setValue('response_body', JSON.stringify(responseBody));
        log.setValue('status', httpStatus < 400 ? 'success' : 'failure');
        log.setValue('duration_ms', durationMs);
        if (caseId) log.setValue('case_id', caseId);
        log.insert();
    } catch (e) {
        gs.error('Failed to log webhook: ' + e.toString());
    }
}
]]></operation_script>
